mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is stable or declining, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100) during industrial contraction periods reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 0) indicates strengthening economic fundamentals that support corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent job growth deceleration (PAYEMS decline) and rising unemployment (UNRATE increase) indicate labor market weakening that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturns (HOUST below 1300 thousand units) during residential investment contractions reduce consumer confidence and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
